description: This file contains test cases for the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator component, specifically validating command resolution logic against pre-defined fixtures and expectations in a macOS environment. It defines test structures, loads fixture data, and performs various validation checks on command resolution outcomes.

classes.name: ExecSystemRunCommandValidatorTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test functions to validate the command resolution logic of ExecSystemRunCommandValidator against various scenarios.

methods.name: matches shared system run command contract fixture
